The '''standard model of particle physics''' explains the hundreds of [[quantum particle]]s known to human and their various simple and complex interactions by less than 20 [[fundamental particle]]s.

== Current model ==

[[File:Reality stew.png|thumbnail]]

As of 2026, the current standard model of particle physics include 17 [[fundamental particles]] and their corresponding [[antiparticle]]s confirmed to exist:

* 6 [[lepton]]s and their antileptons,
* 6 [[quark]]s and their antiquarks,
* 5 [[boson]]s and their antibosons.

All known matter particles are composites of quarks and leptons, and they interact by exchanging bosons.
